newsitem.title: USA: US July air cargo traffic growth up 6.4 pct - ATA.
newsitem.headline: US July air cargo traffic growth up 6.4 pct - ATA.

text.p: U.S. airliners' air cargo traffic grew 6.4 percent in July compared to the same month last year, the Air Transport Association (ATA) said on Wednesday.
"This increase has made July the strongest month so far in 1996," ATA President Carol Hallet said in a statement.

"Although these figures do not stand up to the double- digit growth we saw early last year and throughout 1994, it is an improvement to the growth we had been experiencing so far this year," she said.
Domestic freight and express cargo traffic rose 6.8 percent in the month and international freight and express traffic rose 5.8 percent against July 1995, the airline trade association said.
Both domestic and international mail traffic rose 6.8 percent in July against the same month last year.
